messages:
maria (docs): Noticing two support tickets where /v1/classify returns 400 when clients send an empty string for label_filter. I opened a docs PR but need consensus on examples and param table.

sam (platform): Repro'd. Backend treats missing labels same as empty array, but validation rejects empty string for label_filter (minLength=1).

kai (eng-runtime): Can you paste minimal failing payload?

sam (platform): Sure:

POST /v1/classify
{ "model": "open-classifier-1", "input": "Is this spam?", "label_filter": "" }

Response: 400 validation error (label_filter must be null or non-empty string).

maria (docs): Proposal for docs: show three compact examples — omit label_filter, explicit null, and comma-separated labels. Add param table note: type string | null, required: no, example: null / "spam,phish"; add validation note: empty string rejected.

dmitri (sdk): For JS SDK I'll strip empty-string params before sending. Small PR coming.

anna (support): Two customers hit this because frontend defaulted to empty string. I'll add KB once docs live.

kai (eng-runtime): We could accept empty string server-side and treat as null for compatibility, but that may mask bugs. Prefer docs + SDK helper for now.

maria (docs): Agreed. Action items: dmitri to patch SDK, anna to prepare KB, sam to grep for other string|null fields, kai to add a code comment for later. I added a tiny JS snippet for docs: function cleanParams(params) { return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(params).filter(([k,v]) => v !== "")); }

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/468 (maria updated classify examples).

maria (docs): Merging after SDK patch. Will add frontmatter note: if your client might send empty strings, prefer null or omit the field. Thread closed for now.
